lines.say: The guard said I was the ninth witness.
I asked about the first eight.
He took me down to level ten.
Your job, he said. Watch the door.
Whatever comes through, you must see it. Unseen things cannot stay.
Behind the glass sat an old man in a guard's jacket.
The eighth witness. Thirty years in that chair.
He pressed his face to the glass and mouthed one word. Run.
